verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Q-E all-ins while his E (Umbral Dash) is up; you win if you drag the lane past level 9 with Q (Obliterate) maxed and items online.

brief.thesis: Aatrox has a real gap closer and sustain (E's passive heal on damaging champions plus his Deathbringer Stance empowered auto) while your only engage tool is E (Death's Grasp), a 700-range pull with a 16-second base cooldown. He picks the fights until his E (Umbral Dash, 9/8/7/6/5s) is down; you only get to pick them when it isn't. The 44.4% win rate over 151 games and OP.GG's own defensive read confirm this is a lane you survive, not one you push.

theirWindow.when: his E is up and Deathbringer Stance is ready
theirWindow.what: He can dash in with E, threaten a Q-Q-Q sequence, and land an empowered auto that heals off your max health. Play for W (Indestructible) shield uptime and don't stand still for the third Q swing.

yourWindow.when: his E is on cooldown after a dash or trade
yourWindow.what: He has no escape from your E (Death's Grasp) and no healing from a dash-in auto. Walk up, land Obliterate point-blank for the single-target bonus, and follow with Death's Grasp if he tries to walk off.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Highest win rate in this exact matchup (48.5% over 136 games, 72.7% pick) — the extra sustain and mana let you match his early poke without losing trades outright.

boots.why: Best performer here (51.1% over 133 games, 83.1% pick) — flat physical damage reduction directly cuts his auto-attacks, Q swings, and empowered Deathbringer Stance hit.

core.why: OP.GG's own tip for this matchup — the passive heal-cut blunts both Deathbringer Stance and his E sustain, and it's the highest-sampled winning core path (66.7%).
Slow from Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) helps you actually keep him inside Death's Grasp range instead of letting him walk out.
Omnivamp lets your W (Indestructible) shield-and-heal loop outlast his burst in extended trades.
Rounds out the magic damage core so your Q hits harder once trades go past level 10.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-picked page for this matchup (42.2% pick, 48.7% WR) — Conqueror's stacking damage rewards the extended trades you're forced into by his higher early damage.

summoners.why: Most-picked and highest win-rate combo here (84.4% pick, 49.3% WR) — Ignite punishes his Deathbringer Stance and E healing directly, since it cuts the same health pool he's trying to regain.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Umbral Dash is his only gap closer and escape, cycling every 9/8/7/6/5s. Only initiate with Q (Obliterate) when it's down.

playing.title: Hold W before trades
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can pop to heal. Pre-cast it before he engages, not after.

playing.title: Punish overextensions with E
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in its 700-range area — use it to drag him back before he can walk off with a Q3 or empowered auto.

playing.title: Save R for isolation
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags only him into your dimension. Use it once he's overextended past minion wave, not as a first-strike tool.

playing.title: Don't fight his empowered auto
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance procs periodically and heals him off your max health when it lands. Step out of auto range when you see the glow.

playing.title: Play the long game
playing.detail: This is a defensive-shape matchup — trade passively, keep wave state neutral, and wait for Bramble Vest/Rylai's to come online before forcing anything.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing advice are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo when fighting him. Purchase Bramble Vest to gain the upper hand when fighting him.
